extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: This policy documents our coverage and billing requirements for services provided by a

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC). These are outpatient facilities that provide primary

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: and preventive health care services to medically underserved areas and populations that

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: would otherwise be provided in an outpatient clinic or physicianʼs office.1

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to all Devoted Health plans.

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: When you see one of our members at your FQHC, we cover face-to-face encounters between

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: the patient and a Physician, Physician Assistant (PA), Nurse Practitioner (NP), Certified Nurse

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: Midwife (CNM), Visiting Nurse, Clinical Psychologist (CP) or Clinical Social Worker (CSW)

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: during which a FQHC service is rendered.

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: FQHCs can bill for a face-to-face, medically necessary visit furnished by a dentist, podiatrist,

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: optometrist, or chiropractor if the service furnished is on the list of qualifying visits for the

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: FQHC and all other requirements are met. All services furnished must be within the state

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: scope of practice for the practitioner and all HCPCS codes must reflect the actual services that

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: FQHC services include, but are not limited to:

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: ○ High Intensity Behavioral Counseling to Prevent Sexually Transmitted

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: ○ Intensive Behavioral Therapy for Cardiovascular Disease

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: Devoted Health uses the CMS list of approved payment and qualifying visit codes to

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: When multiple practitioners see our member on the same day, we generally consider it one

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: payable encounter. For example, if a member comes in to see an optometrist for an eye exam

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: and then sees their PCP for a wellness visit, it is still one payable encounter. However, If you

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: have discharged our member and they return on the same day for the diagnosis and/or

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: treatment of a new acute medical issue, we will consider this as a second payable encounter.

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: Mental health services provided on the same day as medical services are covered as a

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: separate encounter but are subject to the same limitations. CMS requires that same-day

extracted_content.title: OVERVIEW
extracted_content.content: encounters be clearly distinct and medically justified in order to be paid separately (CMS

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Claims for FQHC services payable under the PPS need to be submitted on a CMS-1450

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: (UB-04) or X12 837I electronic equivalent with bill type 0771-0779 and include the

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: appropriate revenue, payment, and qualifying visit codes. Payment codes are reported on the

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: first line of the claim with a corresponding line that includes the CPT or HCPCS code that

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: Preventive services provided on the same date of service as another qualifying visit are not

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: separately payable (unless addressed in the Vaccines section below), but a payment code

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: that represents both payment codes and visit codes must be reported to ensure our member

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: does not incur cost share. Separate and distinct medical encounters on the same date of

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: service require a payment and CPT code for each qualifying visit and include modifier 59 on

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: the claim line for the second visit.

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: We reimburse claims according to Medicare FQHC PPS payment rules except for items paid

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: by cost report and reimbursement is global for all services provided on the same day, except

extracted_content.title: HOW TO BILL YOUR CLAIMS
extracted_content.content: as noted in this section. Please refer to your contract for specific reimbursement details.
